episodes.title: Onikakushi-hen Sono Ichi – Hajimari
episodes.summary: The Spirited Away by the Demon Chapter - Part 1 - The BeginningKeiichi adapts to rural life in Hinamizawa by befriending cute classmates Rena, Mion, Satoko, and Rika - but he's appalled to learn of a gruesome murder in the village's past.

episodes.title: Onikakushi-hen Sono Ni – Kakushigoto
episodes.summary: The Spirited Away by the Demon Chapter - Part 2 - The SecretThe police ask Keiichi to be an informant after an acquaintance of his is found dead. When Keiichi accuses Rena of withholding information, she cryptically tells him that everyone has secrets to hide.

episodes.title: Onikakushi-hen Sono San – Gishin
episodes.summary: The Spirited Away by the Demon Chapter - Part 3 - SuspicionKeiichi learns his classmates knew of his secret meeting with Oishi and discovers disturbing information about Rena's past. As his paranoia escalates, it becomes clear that someone is trying to kill him!

episodes.title: Onikakushi-hen Sono Yon – Yugami
episodes.summary: The Spirited Away by the Demon Chapter - Part 4 - DisturbanceUnnerved by Rena and Mion's menacing behavior, Keiichi begins to distance himself from his former friends - but it might be too late. On the way home from school, Keiichi is attacked!

episodes.title: Watanagashi-hen Sono Ichi – Shitto
episodes.summary: The Cotton Drifting Chapter - Part 1 - JealousyKeiichi meets a pretty waitress who introduces herself as Shion - the younger twin sister of Mion. He's definitely skeptical and believes it's a trick, but Keiichi plays along.

episodes.title: Watanagashi-hen Sono Ni – Takano
episodes.summary: The Cotton Drifting Chapter - Part 2 - TakanoAfter sneaking into a sacred shrine with Keiichi and Shion, Tomitake and Takano are reported dead. Could it be that Keiichi and Shion will be the next victims of Oyashiro-sama's curse?

episodes.title: Watanagashi-hen Sono San – Uso
episodes.summary: The Cotton Drifting Chapter - Part 3 - LiesKeiichi indirectly confesses to Rika about sneaking into the forbidden shrine, and his admission may have put Rika and Satako's lives in danger. Soon after, the girls go missing.

episodes.title: Watanagashi-hen Sono Yon – Negai
episodes.summary: The Cotton Drifting Chapter - Part 4 - Wish

episodes.title: Tatarigoroshi-hen Sono Ichi – Ani
episodes.summary: The Curse Killing Chapter - Part 1 - Older BrotherKeiichi hears the odd circumstances surrounding Satoko's older brother, Satoshi. It seems he simply left the village, but when Keiichi mentions Satoshi to Shion and Rena, each reacts in an unusual manner.

episodes.title: Tatarigoroshi-hen Sono Ni – Kizuna
episodes.summary: The Curse Killing Chapter - Part 2 - BondSatoko's violent uncle Teppei is back in town, and she's been missing class. Keiichi witnesses the physical abuse inflicted upon Satoko - and her damaged psyche may have reached the breaking point.

episodes.title: Tatarigoroshi-hen Sono San – Sakaime
episodes.summary: The Curse Killing Chapter - Part 3 - BoundaryFollowing Satoko's disturbing panic attack in the classroom, Keiichi's concern for her well-being grows to the point where he plans to take matters into his own hands.

episodes.title: Tatarigoroshi-hen Sono Yon – Nakushimono
episodes.summary: The Curse Killing Chapter - Part 4 - Something LostAfter strange encounters with Takano, Dr. Irie, and Inspector Oishi, Keiichi starts to question whether the previous night's incident actually occurred.

episodes.title: Tatarigoroshi-hen Sono Go – Shazai
episodes.summary: The Curse Killing Chapter - Part 5 - ApologyWhen Keiichi heads to Satoko's house and finds her in need of medical attention, he becomes convinced that Oyashiro-sama's curse may be the cause of all these recent misfortunes.

episodes.title: Himatsubushi-hen Sono Ichi – Hinamizawa
episodes.summary: The Time Wasting Chapter - Part 1 - HinamizawaFour years ago, during the Hinamizawa dam incident, young police investigator Mamoru Akasaka comes to the village to investigate a child kidnapping, where he meets young Rika.

episodes.title: Himatsubushi-hen Sono Ni – Kizash
episodes.summary: The Time Wasting Chapter - Part 2 - OmenMamoru and Oishi discover some important clues, and head to the district of Takatsudo to continue the search for the Cabinet Minister's son. Little do they know, there are much more sinister forces at work.

episodes.title: Meakashi-hen Sono Ichi – Hatsukoi
episodes.summary: The Eye Opening Chapter - Part 1 - First LoveThe events from The Cotton Drifting Chapter are retold from another point of view. After two years away from the village, Shion comes back to Hinamizawa.

episodes.title: Meakashi-hen Sono Ni – Kejime
episodes.summary: The Eye Opening Chapter - Part 2 - DistinctionThe recent incident at school has left Shion feeling very uneasy. She is able to muster the courage to call Satoshi, only to receive an apology from him. Something doesn't seem right.

episodes.title: Meakashi-hen Sono San – Oni no Ketsumyaku
episodes.summary: The Eye Opening Chapter - Part 3 - Demon's BloodWhen Shion decides to investigate Satoshi's disappearance, she meets Takano at the library, who tells her more about the dark history of Hinamizawa. The very next year, the past begins to repeat itself.

episodes.title: Meakashi-hen Sono Yon – Shikaeshi
episodes.summary: The Eye Opening Chapter - Part 4 - RetaliationShion overhears a conversation between Mion and her grandmother and begins to suspect her family may be involved in the recent events.

episodes.title: Meakashi-hen Sono Go – Tsumetai Te
episodes.summary: The Eye Opening Chapter - Part 5 - Cold HandsAfter questioning Headmaster Kimiyoshi for information about the previous murders and Satoshi's disappearance, Shion sets her sights on another one of the Three Great Families.

episodes.title: Meakashi-hen Sono Roku – Danzai
episodes.summary: The Eye Opening Chapter - Part 6 - ConvictionShion tricks Keiichi into thinking that he may have put his friends in danger. However, when he figures out the truth, Shion is confronted by Keiichi and Rena.

episodes.title: Tsumihoroboshi-hen Sono Ichi – Shiawase
episodes.summary: The Atonement Chapter - Part 1 - HappinessAt school, Rena's attitude brings smiles to everyone around her - but things are different at home. Her mother left the family for another man, and she worries her father's new girlfriend is only after his money.

episodes.title: Tsumihoroboshi-hen Sono Ni – Kaeru Tokoro
episodes.summary: The Atonement Chapter - Part 2 - A Place to Return toAfter Rena learns of Rina's plot to extort money from her father, a confrontation at a deserted landfill triggers another disastrous chain of events.

episodes.title: Tsumihoroboshi Hen Sono San: 34-gou Bunsho
episodes.summary: The Atonement Chapter - Part 3 - File No. 34When Rena confides her tragic past to Takano, who seems to know the cause behind her strange behavior, he hands her a scrapbook containing the evil conspiracy theories behind Oyashiro-sama's curse.

episodes.title: Tsumihoroboshi-hen Sono Yon – Chikyuu Shinryaku
episodes.summary: The Atonement Chapter - Part 4 - Earth InvasionRena tells Oishi that aliens are behind the mysterious murders - and they're planning a massive biological attack on Hinamizawa. Has she gone mad, or does Rena have an evil agenda of her own?

episodes.title: Tsumihoroboshi-hen Sono Go – Riteiku
episodes.summary: The Atonement Chapter - Part 5 - RetakeRena takes the school hostage using a homemade bomb and demands the police investigate the Sonozaki family's connection to Oyashiro-sama's curse. Can Keiichi save his classmates from being burned alive?

episodes.title: Saikai
episodes.summary: ReunionMamoru Akasaka, Oishi and the assistant visit the abandoned village in 2007. They learn about the Great Hinamizawa Disaster that decimated the town and the connection to Miyo's File No. 34.

episodes.title: Yakusamashi-hen Sono Ichi: Onigokko
episodes.summary: The Disaster Awakening Chapter - Part 1 - Playing TagBack in 1983, the club participates in a game of 'zombie tag'. On their way home, they run into Irie, Tomitake and Miyo, who tell Keiichi about the past murders.

episodes.title: Yakusamashi-hen Sono Ni: Muryoku
episodes.summary: The Disaster Awakening Chapter - Part 2 - PowerlessnessSatoko attempts to help Rika, but she denies that anything is wrong. That night, Satoko discovers Rika arguing with a mysterious voice and telling her she will die, and that there is nothing that either of them can do.

episodes.title: Yakusamashi-hen Sono San: Yotei Chouwa
episodes.summary: The Disaster Awakening Chapter - Part 3 - Pre-established HarmonyDuring the festival, Rika fails to warn Tomitake of his imminent death. Satoko is convinced that a mysterious man is following her and Rika around.

episodes.title: Yakusamashi-hen Sono Yon: Hinamizawa Daisaigai
episodes.summary: The Disaster Awakening Chapter - Part 4 - The Great Hinamizawa DisasterRika hides Satoko in the house.

episodes.title: Minagoroshi-hen Sono Ichi: Meiro no Housoku
episodes.summary: The Massacre Chapter - Part 1 - Law of the LabyrinthRika begins a new world with Hanyu.

episodes.title: Minagoroshi-hen Sono Ni: Unmei no Kaekata
episodes.summary: The Massacre Chapter - Part 2 - How to Change DestinyInfluenced by Keiichi's encouragement, and the fact her friends are starting to avoid doing the same mistakes by remembering glimpses of what they could have done, Rika decides to find a way to prevent her own ominous destiny.

episodes.title: Minagoroshi-hen Sono San: Yuragi
episodes.summary: The Massacre Chapter - Part 3 - FluctuationRika's plans are hindered by the appearance of Teppei, who continues to abuse Satoko. Keiichi and the rest of the gang decide to find a way to release Satoko, but the government is reluctant to cooperate.

episodes.title: Minagoroshi-hen Sono Yon: Koushou
episodes.summary: The Massacre Chapter - Part 4 - NegotiationThe townspeople protest alongside the others to ignite government action in the case of Satoko.

episodes.title: Minagoroshi-hen Sono Go: Taiketsu
episodes.summary: The Massacre Chapter - Part 5 - ConfrontationKeiichi struggles to take the village's neighborhood council to make an appeal for the government. Citizens from Okinomiya and Hinamizawa protest in front of the Counseling Center, calling for action from the director.

episodes.title: Minagoroshi-hen Sono Roku: Tsuyoi Ishi
episodes.summary: The Massacre Chapter - Part 6 - Strong WillKnowing that Tomitake and Miyo will die on the night in all of the other worlds she has been in, Rika enlists the help of Oishi and her friends to protect the two.

episodes.title: Minagoroshi-hen Sono Nana: Hinamizawa Shoukougun
episodes.summary: The Massacre Chapter - Part 7 - The Hinamizawa SyndromeRika tells her friends the details of the Hinamizawa Syndrome.

episodes.title: Minagoroshi-hen Sono Hachi: Shuumatsu
episodes.summary: The Massacre Chapter - Part 8 - ClosureKeiichi, Rena, Mion and Shion leave the house to the officers for the night. As Satoko sleeps, Rika talks with Hanyuu about Rika's fated death.

episodes.title: Matsuribayashi-hen Sono Ichi: Miyo
episodes.summary: The Festival Accompanying Chapter - Part 1 - MiyoIn a series of flashbacks, Miyo's past is revealed.

episodes.title: Matsuribayashi-hen Sono Ni: Ugomeki
episodes.summary: The Festival Accompanying Chapter - Part 2 - WrigglingMiyo's story continues.

episodes.title: Matsuribayashi-hen Sono San: Owari no Hajimar
episodes.summary: The Festival Accompanying Chapter - Part 3 - The Beginning of the EndThe events of the dam incident are shown, including when the Hojo family first antagonized themselves against the Sonozaki family and the village residents.

episodes.title: Matsuribayashi-hen Sono Yon: Bouryaku
episodes.summary: The Festival Accompanying Chapter - Part 4 - PlotIn order to save Satoko, who is terminally infected with the Hinamizawa Syndrome, Rika offers herself as a test subject for Irie and Miyo's research.

episodes.title: Matsuribayashi-hen Sono Go: Saigo no Koma
episodes.summary: The Festival Accompanying Chapter - Part 5 - The Final PieceIchiro Maebara moves his family into the village, meeting Rika and Hanyu along the way. Rena's mother abandons the family. After purchasing a giant teddy bear, Satoshi succumbs to Hinamizawa Syndrome.

episodes.title: Matsuribayashi-hen Sono Roku: Makuake
episodes.summary: The Festival Accompanying Chapter - Part 6 - OpeningHanyu is introduced into the world as a transfer school student.

episodes.title: Matsuribayashi-hen Sono Nana: Trap
episodes.summary: The Festival Accompanying Chapter - Part 7 - TrapRika, Oishi and Akasaka present Miyo as the culprit to Irie and Tomitake, and eventually enlists the help of Tomitake to gather incriminating evidence in the shadows.

episodes.title: Matsuribayashi-hen Sono Hachi: 48-jikan
episodes.summary: The Festival Accompanying Chapter - Part 8 - 48 HoursMiyo, oblivious of Tomitake and Irie's betrayal, continues on with her plan. Oishi confirms with Rika and her friends that the local precinct is on board with the announcement of Rika's death, set to be announced at dawn.

episodes.title: Matsuribayashi-hen Sono Kyuu: Koubou
episodes.summary: The Festival Accompanying Chapter - Part 9 - Offense and DefenseTomitake is sent to the clinic. Irie sees this and escapes from there by car. Meanwhile, Rika and her friends hide under the Sonozaki estate.

episodes.title: Matsuribayashi-hen Sono Juu: Kessen
episodes.summary: The Festival Accompanying Chapter - Part 10 - Bloody BattleMiyo interrogates with Tomitake, but is informed about Rika and takes command of the group to capture Keiichi's friends. The soldiers move out en masse to the mountains around the Sonozaki estate where Rika and company are located.

episodes.title: Matsuribayashi-hen Sono Juuichi: Oshimai
episodes.summary: The Festival Accompanying Chapter - Part 11 - EndAkasaka and Tomitake break through the road blockade and make it to the city, where they call for the activation of the Banken combat unit to arrest Miyo and the remaining forces. The rest of them concede defeat, but Miyo cannot surrender. She flees into the mountains and confronts Rika and her friends.
